items.label: All-in-One Real Kids Smart Phone for Learning, Fun & Safety
items.value: The world’s first kids’ smartphone with an auto-focus camera combines phone and tablet functions for all-around learning and entertainment. It supports calls, texts, WiFi, Bluetooth, and location, keeping kid safely connected. With a smooth full-touch display, it offers a smarter, seamless experience for growing children.NOTICE: SIM card NOT included. Purchase separately.

items.label: HD Eye-Protect Screen & Dual Powerful Cameras
items.value: Equipped with a 4.2" IPS eye-protection screen and 200W pixels front + 1300W pixels rear dual cameras, this kids cell phone supports autofocus, selfies, video recording, and burst shooting. The vivid image quality protects eyesight while capturing every wonderful moment of childhood.

items.label: Over 270+ Educational & Entertainment Content
items.value: Loaded with Montessori learning apps, STEM activities, logic games, children’s videos, and fun themes, this toddler phone makes learning enjoyable. It encourages creativity, problem-solving, and healthy screen time through interactive educational play.

items.label: 48GB Large Storage & Long-Lasting Battery Life
items.value: This kids phone with wifi includes 16GB built-in storage plus a free 32GB SD card(Pre-installed in the phone) —enough space for photos, videos, and learning materials. The 3500mAh polymer battery supports fast charging and long use, allowing children to study and play all day.

items.label: Advanced Parental Controls for Peace of Mind
items.value: Parents can manage app access, set screen time limits, view usage reports, and enable whitelist mode to ensure safe contact. No app store and no internet browsing. This kids phone for 5-14 texting and calling helps build good digital habits while keeping your child protected online.

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Big Screen, 48GB Storage, 24H Standby, Phone, Text, Camera, Games, Video, Music, Free Learning App
